Finding: McLaren remained 1st in the constructors' championship in both 2024 and 2025.
McLaren championship points increased from 666 to 833, an increase of 25.08%.
McLaren race wins increased from 6 to 14, an increase of 133.33%.
The extracted vehicle weight increased from 798 kg to 800 kg.
MGU-K and MGU-H were available as numerical technical specifications in the 2025 data but were not available in the 2024 extracted data.
Other common numerical technical specifications showed no measurable change between the two seasons.
The available data indicates an association between the observed technical data and performance improvement.
The analysis does not prove that a particular technical change caused the performance improvement.
More seasons, more teams, and additional technical variables would be required for stronger statistical analysis.
